A '''shovelvac''' was a tool used for maintenance and cleanup, particularly for clearing accumulated debris and storm deposits. Using one causes  a loud noise to mask other sounds in the surrounding area.<ref name="TG" />

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], a [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] was using a shovelvac to clear the area around [[Kitster Chanchani Banai]]'s [[Banai house|house]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TG" />
